verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: independently reconcile the Xenoverse 2 identity, mentor acquisition route, Ki cost, and documented mechanics. Preserve unresolved stamina/probability fields as null.
research_scope: Deadly Dance — Strike Super / Android 18 training research.

verification_audit.method: Compared the repository seeded Strike Super index with current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation and independent Xenoverse 2 references.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Deadly Dance was found. The canonical identity is Super / Strike.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2-specific documentation classifies Deadly Dance as a Strike Super Attack. Its Ki-Blast-deflecting behavior is retained as a mechanic rather than creating a separate counter identity.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Deadly Dance is obtained through Training with Android 18. Independent references identify it as an Android 18 mentor Super Skill and confirm the Xenoverse 2 training route.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the documented acquisition route is mentor training rather than a Parallel Quest reward.
verification_audit.cost_policy: The documented Ki cost is 100; stamina cost remains null because the reviewed canonical sources do not establish a reliable stamina value.

records.name: Deadly Dance
records.character_source: Android 18 / Android 18 (DB Super) / Krillin customizable partner / Android 17 (DB Super) customizable partner / Kefla (Super Saiyan) customizable partner
records.skill_description: A series of dance-like kicks that can repel weak Ki Blasts and ends with a launching somersault kick.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 skill reference describes sequential kicks followed by a launching somersault kick. The move is characterized as kick-based, deflecting, five-hit, and launching; the opponent remains airborne long enough for follow-up attacks. Exact damage and frame values are not promoted to canonical numeric data.
records.acquisition_notes: Deadly Dance is the third Super Skill in Android 18's mentor training route. Later partner customization can make the skill available to additional compatible partners.
records.pve_notes: Mentor training acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: The move can repel weak Ki Blasts during its attack and provides a launching ender; detailed matchup and frame claims remain version-sensitive.
